name: YITAMOTOR Floor Mats for 2012-2015 Honda Civic Sedan (Not for Coupe) & Civic Si EX EX-L HF Hybrid Hybrid-L LX Natural Gas SE, Black All-Weather Custom Fit Front 1st & 2nd Row Floor Liner Set
fitment:
2012-2015 Honda Civic(Not fit for 2 doors coupe model )
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
YITAMOTOR floor mats completely line the interior carpet to provide all-encompassing protection. We are confident that our products will surpass your expectations and make you a happy customer!
Fitment
2012-2015 Honda Civic(Not fit for 2 doors coupe model )
For your safety, professional installation is highly recommended.
Features
Custom Fit: Compatible with 2012 2013 2014 2015 Honda Civic, Applies unique precision digital laser scanning to ensure and accurate interior carpet lining, Please remember to double-check the car model before ordering. NOTE: Includes 2 front floor mats & 1 rear floor liner,Only for 4 doors, not for coupe.
All-Weather Guard: Built using TPE tri-extruded composition that is safe, odorless, and environmentally sound in all weather conditions (rain, fog, snow, etc.); Floor liners provide protection to the front and rear of your car
Tough & Durable: Offers Better temperature resistance than PVC materials; The mats are odorless, contain no latex, cadmium, lead or harmful PVC; High tensity TPE material provides a superb feel and extreme wear-resistance, as well as constant flexibility even in harsh cold weather
Non-Slip Design & Easy To Clean: Floor mats provide a rugged and durable grip that will not slip; Can be conveniently wiped down to not accumulate stains; High-density core materials trap milk, snow, dirt, sand, etc., to keep your car and shoes clean; Get your vehicle carpets looking nice and new once again
Why Choose YITAMOTOR: Our floor mats are processed with advanced technology, rendering tailored protection and all-weather guard to your vehicle.
highlights: They securely attach to your vehicle using the original factory clasps, keeping the floor liners firmly in place and preventing unwanted shifting during daily driving.
The raised edges provide maximum vehicle coverage, Floor Liners accurately and completely line the vehicle carpet giving absolute interior protection.
Specially designed channels ensure the liner effectively contain the liquid to keep your vehicle and shoes clean, non-slip design for safe driving.

specifications.Special features: Solid, easy to install, easy to clean, precision 3d laser measured, perfect fit, waterproof, anti-slip, durable, non-toxic tpe material, all-weather protection
